blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. In "Turning On and Off", you learn the simple English you need when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting.

Today you learn five useful words: turn on, turn off, plug in, unplug and restart. You practise them in short, natural sentences. Good IT habits are small, but they protect the whole company.

Go slow — one step at a time. Sophie calls IT support when something looks strange. The IT team is small, but very fast. You can do it!

items.q: Who does IT support at Czarnikow?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five useful words."

items.q: What does Sophie do when something looks strange?
options: She writes an email to London
items.why: "Sophie calls IT support when something looks strange."

items.q: The text says "go slow — one step at a time". This suggests that…
options: the lesson is difficult and stressful
you do not need to learn fast; it is okay to take your time
items.why: Inferência: o tom é calmo e encorajador — um passo de cada vez, sem pressa.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: good IT habits help the whole company
only the IT team needs English
you should never call the help desk
small IT habits are not important
items.why: Inferência: "Good IT habits are small, but they protect the whole company."

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicar, passo a passo, como ligar e desligar o computador. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, I'm James from IT. Today I show you how to turn on and off your workstation. It is easy. Just follow me, one step at a time.

First, plug in the computer. Put the cable in the wall. Then press the button. The computer will turn on. Wait a little. Do not press many buttons. Just wait.

When you finish your work, save your files first. This is very important. Then close all your programs. Now you can turn off the computer. Press the button again and wait.

Sometimes the computer is slow or strange. Do not worry. Just restart it. Turn it off, wait ten seconds, and turn it on again. Many small problems go away after a restart.

At the end of the day, you can unplug the computer if you want. Take the cable out of the wall. That is all. Good IT habits are small, but they help everyone. Thank you, and have a good day.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does James show you today?
options: How to turn on and off your workstation
How to join a meeting in London
items.why: "Today I show you how to turn on and off your workstation."

items.q: What is the FIRST step?
items.why: "First, plug in the computer. Put the cable in the wall."

items.q: What should you do BEFORE you turn off the computer?
items.why: "When you finish your work, save your files first."

items.q: James says small problems often go away after a restart. This suggests that…
options: a restart is a simple thing you can try yourself
you must buy a new computer
you should always call IT first
items.why: Inferência: reiniciar é fácil e resolve muitos problemas pequenos — você pode tentar sozinho.

items.q: How would you best describe James's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "do not worry", "one step at a time" e "have a good day" — é calmo e amigável.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please turn on the computer." Turn on means…
options: to start it / make it work
items.why: Turn on = ligar (fazer funcionar).

items.q: "When you go home, please turn off the lights." Turn off means…
items.why: Turn off = desligar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The screen is black. Did you ___ the cable in the wall?"
items.why: Plug in = conectar na tomada; a tela está preta porque o cabo pode não estar na tomada.

items.q: "At night, we unplug the machine." Unplug means…
options: to take the cable out of the wall
items.why: Unplug = desconectar da tomada (tirar o cabo).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The computer is slow. Please ___ it and try again."
items.why: Restart = reiniciar; ligar de novo para resolver o problema.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que você ouve quando fala com o help desk. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you log in with your password?" To log in means to…
options: enter the system with your name and password
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com usuário e senha.

items.q: "When you finish, please log out." To log out means to…
items.why: Log out = sair do sistema.

items.q: "The Wi-Fi is down. Please hold on." Hold on means…
items.why: Hold on = espere um momento.

items.q: "I can't find the file. Can you help me out?" To help me out means to…
items.why: Help me out = me ajudar.

items.q: "The meeting starts soon. Please set up the laptop." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = preparar/deixar pronto para usar.
